title: Frozen legacy-contract iter16 generic-greedy fresh5k Slumbot gate
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The exact frozen iter16 mixed-league learned policy will improve upon the direct Standard10 bridge reference (-24.5683 bb/100 fresh20k) in eight independent fresh625 generic-greedy Slumbot sessions, with raw CI upper above zero and at least four positive sessions, justifying a separate fresh20k confirmation.
material_change: Evaluate only exact checkpoint SHA256 0b1b58a87637f620ae580754bc940ec7aca246d94762d77717c9b578aac9f290 through the generic legacy-v4 observation bridge, greedy physical execution, eight independent sessions and seeds, 625 fresh hands each. No tactics, overrides, retries, replacement sessions, or training.
baseline: Untouched Standard10 bridge fresh20k -24.5683 bb/100 CI[-42.8407,-6.2959], fresh5k -15.79 CI[-46.7802,15.2002]. Iter16 independently passed internal replication at +14.9376 versus parent with adjusted lower +2.3311; that is allocation evidence only.
notes: Fresh20k admission requires candidate point > -24.5683, raw 95% CI upper >0, at least 4/8 positive sessions, and all evidence audits PASS. Fresh5k cannot satisfy the goal.
Raw-hand CI independently recomputed with explicit parent bridge baseline -24.5683. Observable-deal/session-independence audit passed all checks; each session had exact 313 BB and 312 SB hands.

result.summary: Exact frozen iter16 completed eight independent fresh625 generic-greedy bridge sessions at +19.46 bb/100, raw 95% CI [-29.0203,67.9403], session-t7 CI [-35.7465,74.6665], and 6/8 positive sessions. All 5,000 raw hands passed bridge replay, token/evidence and deal-independence audits.
result.conclusion: The learned mixed-league iter16 policy improves the direct Standard10 bridge point by +44.0283 bb/100 on this fresh5k cohort and clears the preregistered bounded allocation gate. Variance remains large and the lower CI is negative, so this is not a win claim or qualification evidence.
result.next_step: Run a separate eight-session fresh20k confirmation of the same exact SHA256 and generic bridge greedy contract. Continue to a new fresh100k qualification only if the 20k point is above zero, raw CI upper is positive, evidence audits pass, and the prespecified confirmation gate supports the allocation.
